item.title: netoze 2.0.0 Released: Elite Digital Infrastructure & Local Network Monitoring
item.description: Initial stable desktop release of netoze 2.0.0 for Windows 10/11 and Linux x86_64. Features native packet capture, host process-to-socket correlation, and zero-telemetry local storage.
